'''Supertransports''' were a type of [[Transport/Legends|transport]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc./Legends|Hoersch-Kessel Drive, Inc.]] specialized in building supertransports and [[Container ship/Legends|container ships]].<ref name="EGVV" />
